A secret police force known as the Black Guard protects the boundary between the human world and the demon world.
Heroic Yugi squares off against archrival Kaiba in an adventure even more dangerous when the imaginary monsters in their playing cards become ferociously real…and when an old evil enters the fray.
It's a whole new deal! For the first time, Yugi, Jaden And Yusei are together in an all-new adventure!
Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dark Side of Dimensions
The stakes have never been higher, the rivalries never as fierce, the risks never so great. One wrong move - one card short - and it's game over for good.

Robots good and evil star in this '80s sci-fi anime anthology. Stories include evil techno overlords intent on destruction, to a cyborg on a mission to save a young girl, to the story of a beautiful robot creation that haunts its creator, and beyond.
The members of RWBY each have their own journey, but they share a single destination: Haven Academy.
